old_caption: The video captures a young boy standing on a wooden dock by a calm body of water. He is shirtless, wearing patterned swim trunks, and barefoot. The boy begins by raising his arms out to the sides, then bringing them up above his head, and finally lowering them back down to his sides. His movements are fluid and rhythmic. The background features a serene landscape with trees and a clear sky. The water is still, reflecting the light. There are no other characters or animals visible. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a young boy standing on a wooden dock by a calm body of water. He is shirtless, wearing patterned swim trunks, and barefoot. The boy begins by raising his arms out to the sides, then bringing them up above his head, and finally lowering them back down to his sides. His movements are fluid and rhythmic, suggesting he might be practicing a form of exercise or simply enjoying the moment. The background features a serene landscape with trees and a clear sky, indicating a peaceful outdoor setting. The water is still, reflecting the light and adding to the tranquil atmosphere. There are no other characters or animals visible in the scene, focusing the viewer's attention solely on the boy and his actions. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent view of the boy and the surrounding environment.
caption: The video captures a shirtless boy in dark floral swim trunks standing barefoot on a rectangular black mat laid across a wooden dock over a calm lake. A tree-lined far shore stretches beneath a bright sky behind him. The boy stays planted with his legs and feet still, moving only his arms in a repeated swinging exercise. His hands begin near his chest, drop toward his hips, then sweep outward and downward until the arms extend to the sides. The elbows bend and the hands rise again, climbing past shoulder level toward his head and, on later cycles, fully overhead. As the arms lower they pass in front of the torso with visible motion blur before returning to the hips. This outward-and-upward sequence continues through the excerpt with a slight sway of the torso. The clip ends with the arms raised overhead, the motion still in progress.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
